scope: The five source-anchored facade residue meshes created by QualityBlockFacadeWeatheringDetailUpgrade. This contract refines optical edge behavior only; it does not replace the parent manufacture/installation/causality contract.

benchmarkCondition.rule: No generic wet sheen, no painted sun response, no baked contact shadow and no view-independent highlight may be encoded into residue tint or opacity.

physicalModel.assemblyReasoning: Aged facade weathering is treated as a thin deposited dielectric residue on the real host construction surface, not as a freestanding plate or decal with hard rectangular opacity.

geometryVsMaterialDetail.geometry: Causal extent, taper, drift path and irregular perimeter come from source-anchored microgeometry generated from sill edges, balcony drip edges, rail fixings, downpipe/grade exposure and AC drain endpoints.
geometryVsMaterialDetail.material: Optical density, soft deposit perimeter, dry diffuse tint and broad dielectric angular response are shader properties. Sun/shadow/reflection direction is evaluated live and is never painted into albedo.

physicalModel.interface: Residue remains coincident with or microscopically offset from its host surface; the shader does not introduce a fictitious physical thickness, floating shell or light-blocking volume.
exposureAndAging: rain mineral transport below real drip edges
grade splash deposition from ground contact zone
ferrous runoff from real rail base fixings
condensate mineral residue at real AC drain endpoints
physicalModel.angularResponse: Dielectric Schlick Fresnel using F0=0.04 nominal and live light/view vectors; roughness remains high so the deposit cannot behave like metal, varnish or a painted highlight.

materialProfiles.microstructure: low-amplitude stable world-space optical-density variation only
materialProfiles.uvAging: dry/chalked mineral deposit; no wet gloss

materialProfiles.microstructure: low-amplitude stable world-space optical-density variation only
materialProfiles.uvAging: dry soil/mineral residue; strongest near grade, optically fades upward

materialProfiles.microstructure: low-amplitude stable world-space optical-density variation only
materialProfiles.uvAging: oxidized runoff residue is nonmetallic despite ferrous source

materialProfiles.microstructure: low-amplitude stable world-space optical-density variation only
materialProfiles.uvAging: dry mineral tide mark around condensate discharge point

uvSemantics.verticalRibbon: UV0.x runs from left edge 0 to right edge 1; UV0.y runs from causal source 0 to tail 1.
uvSemantics.gradeStrip: UV0.x spans facade run 0..1; UV0.y runs from grade 0 to the irregular causal splash-height boundary 1.
uvSemantics.horizontalEllipse: UV0 center is 0.5,0.5 and perimeter lies on the unit ellipse, enabling radial alpha feathering without resampling a texture mask.
uvSemantics.requiredRange: Every weathering mesh must supply UV0 for every vertex and span approximately 0..1 in both axes.

lodPolicy.strategy: These are five already-combined microdetail renderers and follow the host facade visibility. Do not introduce a speculative distance switch before native 4K temporal evidence because a hard weathering LOD transition could itself create visible pop.
lodPolicy.lod0: full causal geometry and optical feathering
lodPolicy.lod1: same combined geometry pending measured 4K visibility threshold
lodPolicy.lod2: same combined geometry pending measured 4K visibility threshold
lodPolicy.lod3: same combined geometry pending measured 4K visibility threshold
lodPolicy.futureOptimizationRule: Only reduce or remove a residue group after sealed temporal captures demonstrate no visible pop/shimmer at the proposed threshold.

pixelChecks: no hard rectangular/ribbon alpha boundary visible around residues
runoff terminates at real construction source and fades with distance
grade splash is strongest low and fades upward rather than reading as a painted stripe
rust runoff is nonmetallic and has no copper/chrome-like highlight
AC residue reads as a dry diffuse tide mark rather than a glossy puddle
no residue shimmer or popping during temporal evidence
